preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n < 2*10**5 for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The number of rooms n is between 1 and 2*10^5 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k < n for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The number of friends k is less than the number of rooms n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(2 <= xi <= n for xi in x) for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each friend is in a room between 2 and n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(x) == k for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The number of friends k matches the length of the list x for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(corridors) == n-1 for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The number of corridors is n-1 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n for uj, vj in corridors) for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects rooms between 1 and n for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(x)) == k for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases)
preconditions.description: All friends are in different rooms for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(sum(n for n, k, x, corridors in test_cases) <= 2*10**5)
preconditions.description: The sum of the number of rooms over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result == -1 or 1 <= result <= k for result, k in zip(results, ks))
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a number of friends between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or result <= k for result, k in zip(results, ks))
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a number of friends not exceeding k.
